Overall a fantastic app. Absolutely makes things easier and my time more productive. Thanks for creating it.

title: Only app of this kind so far that’s made the cut thanks Dev
body:
I’m a highly unorganized individual. With 3 kids, a company of my own,  a daily commitment to a magnitude of clients at very some very busy dealerships, project managing and securing funding for an array of start up ventures as well as being a partner in a new brokerage that went nationwide in months, it’s become mind blowing making sure 100’s of clients, our sales teams, my employers/ employees needs and wants are assured.

Ive used apps like this but they never end up being useful to the extent I need, as I’m overwhelmed and most of my time is spent multitasking. This reminder app has been the only one I’ve used (name any, I’ve tried it) that seems to keep me on track.

So props to Dev!! (Don’t know Dev but the name was in the review request, I felt he deserved props for this. Also never do app reviews either]). 
I do wish this could integrate with my multiple email accounts and CRMs so I could have better time management and automatically added reminders and updated finished, active tasks and prioritized notifications to tasks, and emails as well as deadlines and client updates in our CRM

Based on my assumption Dev is quite fluent  in coding and I’d imagine funding wouldn’t be an issue if this app or devs next one was able to make these previous mentioned above integrations happen it would be very helpful and worth the fees. Reach out if you’d like to discuss this but either way thanks for the help thus far!! To Dev and his team!!

title: Amazing app
body:
Amazing app. The UI is clean and seeing tasks and habits is very useful all in one screen. Keeps me focused on what I need to do and love that tasks auto move to the next day. 

Didnt give full stars because there are many areas needed for improvement. 

The calendar is nice but doesnt really work. I only want to sync some calendars but when selecting which calendars to choose from the app does not save my settings and syncs everything. Also for events that have finished, it would be nice for those to be hidden since they are completed. Especially for busy days the list gets far too long if the events dont auto hide. 

The habits are wonderful but how you check off that you completed a habit for the day or made progress on one is very tedious and quite annoying. You have to click into the habit to increment. Would be much easier to mark the habit from the home screen, similar to tasks, especially for those once a day habits. 

The tasks are clean and I like that they are colour coordinated but some of the features are too hidden. For one, quick adding a task by clicking the day is great, but intuitively I click the + at the bottom right. The + at the bottom right would be better made for just tasks than grouping it with habits and reoccurring events, since those two options are likely already pre-set and not something you add constantly (suggestion to move those elsewhere). Secondly the subtasks are fantastic but become useless if I cant see them on the home page. Ideally they would be collapsable so that as I complete them clicking them is easier. 

Overall it is a clean looking app I plan to keep using but it could be significantly improved by removing the tedious amount of extra tapping/clicking you have to do for everyday actions.
